newsitem.title: UK: NWE straight-run fuel oil slips $1 but Russian qui.
newsitem.headline: NWE straight-run fuel oil slips $1 but Russian qui.

text.p: NWE low sulphur straight-run fuel oil slipped about $1 a tonne amid good supply and poor demand which continued to undermine price, traders said.
Demand into the U.S. continues to suck Scandinavia barrels across the Atlantic but local demand in Europea remains muted.
"Russian just makes more sense at the moment but it was quiet today," said a refiner.
He said supplies of good quality E-4 have reduced sharply in recent days but expected supplies of low water cargoes to pick up again next week. -- London newsroom +44 171 542 8167
